CustomObject.label: OI Graph Node Archive
CustomObject.description: Append-only archive for node versions superseded by later scans or purged after soft-deletion (DataModel.md §3.1, ADR-0014). Written exclusively by OI_GraphRepository's OI_BigObjectStorageProvider. Index deliberately limited to Node_Key__c + Version_Number__c + Archived_At__c — a Big Object index caps combined text-field length at 100 characters, which the full five-field index this schema originally specified could not fit; Node_Version_Key__c and Scan_Run_Id__c remain queryable fields, just not part of this index (documented platform-limitation deviation, see Sprint 7 deliverables report).
